info.name: Influencer Marketing API
info.description: Postman requests for the platform’s authentication, account, campaign, content, payment, messaging, notification and reporting workflows. Set base_url and use credentials in a private local environment. Payment requests require genuine Test Mode responses.

Brand workspace - requires Brand Admin login
Own profile - captures snapshot and revisions
Save editable snapshot - edit profile_json first

request.description: Full replacement. First GET the latest profile; edit creator_profile_json with the current revision. Maximum 10 categories, 10 languages, 20 skills. Name/email/verification cannot be changed. Stale revisions return 409.

item.name: Campaign approval —
item.description: Sign in as Brand for own routes; sign in as Super Admin for admin routes. Copy latest campaign/schedule revisions from review detail. Decisions require reasons. Approval does not publish.

item.name: Campaign lifecycle —
item.description: Brand owns publish/pause/resume/cancel/deletion. Admin allows CANCEL only. Read management state before actions to get latest revision. Deletion is permanent and allowed only for unused drafts. Schedule refresh never takes client clock values.

item.name: Creator campaign discovery —
item.description: Sign in as active Creator. Browse is read-only; list, details and campaign files require an open LIVE campaign and active Brand/catalog choices. Only files returned in visible details can be downloaded. Budget/slots are campaign planning values.

item.name: Creator applications —
item.description: Use an active Creator token. Identity/profile/category/social checks must pass; eligibility rechecks on submit. One application for life per campaign/Creator; withdrawal final. No slots reserved. Fetch application detail to refresh revision.

item.name: Brand applicants —
item.description: Sign in as owning Brand. Read applicant detail before decisions to get current revision. Reasons are visible to the Creator. Approvals reserve a slot atomically; no reversal endpoint. Portfolio excludes verification evidence.

item.name: Razorpay Test Mode campaign funding
item.description: Owning Brand token required. Choose an approved/active INR campaign and its current revision. Amount always comes from the saved budget. Callback values/signature must come from genuine Razorpay Test Checkout; do not invent success. Webhooks require exact raw-body HMAC and event ID; see Getting Started for payment setup.

item.name: Wallet and history
item.description: Use the matching signed-in Brand/Creator token. All amounts are decimal strings in integer paise. Captures create immutable balanced journals; authorization/failure cannot increase wallets. Optional transaction filters: direction=CREDIT|DEBIT, campaignId, from inclusive ISO instant, to exclusive ISO instant; payments use status=AUTHORIZED|CAPTURED|FAILED. Summary rejects query fields. No credit, debit, transfer or withdrawal mutations.

item.name: Brand held campaign funds - transaction history
Filtered financial reports
item.description: Use a token for the route role. Reports include posted INR Test Mode ledger events only. Export matches the filters and is capped at 5,000 rows. Creator exports show only your own released earnings.
